articles.company_name: PennyMac Mortgage Investment Trust Common Shares of Beneficial Interest
articles.summary: PennyMac Mortgage Investment Trust (NYSE: PMT) announced today that its Board of Trustees declared a cash dividend of $0.40 per common share of beneficial interest for the third quarter of 2026. This dividend will be paid on October 23, 2026, to common shareholders of record as of October 8, 2026.
